questions.explanation: 'Every day' shows a habit, so use the present simple with -s for 'she'.
questions.q: She ___ to work by bus every day.

questions.explanation: 'Look!' shows the action is happening now, so use the present continuous.
Facts and scientific truths use the present simple.
'Like' is a stative verb and is not used in the continuous; use present simple.
'Be quiet!' shows the action is happening now: present continuous.
'Every Saturday' shows a routine, so use the present simple.
'Know' is a stative verb, so use the present simple: 'I know'.
'Every morning' shows a habit; with 'she' use 'has'.
'Right now' shows the action is happening at this moment.
Abilities and general truths use the present simple.
'Listen!' shows the action is happening now.
Jobs are permanent situations, so use the present simple.
'Understand' is a stative verb and is not used in the continuous.
'At the moment' shows the action is happening now.
'Want' is a stative verb, so use the present simple: 'wants'.
options: She is wanting a new phone.

questions.explanation: Natural facts always use the present simple.
After 'are' we need verb-ing: 'are watching', not 'are watch'.
options: They are watch TV at the moment.
She is reading a book now.
We go to school by bus.

questions.explanation: An action happening now uses the present continuous.
questions.q: I ___ my keys. I can't find them.

questions.explanation: General truths use the present simple; 'like' is a stative verb.
'Every morning' shows a habit, so use present simple: 'Do you drink'.
